compiled_state.title: As a maintainer, I want project docs updated for external-reviewer integration + auto-resolve
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Update project documentation to reflect the external-reviewer integration + auto-resolve feature.
**Why**: New config key, new CI job, and an extended contract are introduced; reference docs must stay in sync.
**Scope**:
- IN: document pr_comments.bot_authors in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md; document the telemetry-collect CI job + required-checks registration in CI-INTEGRATION.md; confirm review-defenses.md github_comment_id extension is documented; confirm respond-to-pr-comments SKILL.md Phase A/B restructuring is reflected.
- OUT: new standalone docs unless a router gate directs to an ADR; CLAUDE.md edits (Gate 5 requires CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report, not a direct edit).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the doc updates exist for every router gate that fired (config key, CI job, contract), and the completion report includes the DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION block
  ← Satisfies: sc-7  (sc-7: "pr_comments.bot_authors config controls the allowlist ...")

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Apply plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/doc-router.md gates before writing. CLAUDE.md edits require a CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report — do not edit CLAUDE.md directly.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.

comments.body: Apply plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/doc-router.md gates before writing. CLAUDE.md edits require a CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report — do not edit CLAUDE.md directly. If .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md exists, follow it for formatting.
